image_description: A bowl of ice cream sundae sitting on a dark wooden table. The dessert consists of scoops of vanilla and chocolate ice cream, topped with a large swirl of whipped cream and two halves of a fresh strawberry. A gold-colored spoon is inserted into the dessert. The lighting appears to be indoor flash photography, creating distinct highlights on the spoon and whipped cream.
